description: Edit one exact text range in an existing unified knowledge document. Before editing, call `knowledge_read` with `part` equal to `section`; section reads return the exact editable text without headings, trimming, placeholders, added newlines, or runtime annotations. Copy the target text verbatim into `oldString`. Use an empty `oldString` only to replace the whole section. `full` is a rendered reading view and is not an `oldString` source. Returns a plain-text status line.

path.description: Current type-prefixed document path. Document paths must end with `.md`, for example `memory/preferences/editor.md`.

section.description: Document section to edit. Use the same value as `knowledge_read.part` before editing.

oldString.description: Exact text copied from the matching `knowledge_read` section result. Use an empty string only to replace the whole section.
